facts.fact: The finance ministry's special projects unit issued terms of reference for developing the Territory Management modules of SIMple, a planned successor to the municipal system, covering cadastre, property assessment and property tax collection; the document gives its own date as 2025 and no month.

The terms of reference for the SIMple Territory Management modules are funded from a USD 15 million World Bank credit for the Harmonization and Improvement of Statistics in West Africa Project (HISWAP) Cabo Verde.

systems.tiers: Operational in all municipalities; focused on accounting, financial management and budget execution (allocation of revenues and expenses), described as obsolete

systems.owner: Finance ministry special projects unit, World Bank financed
systems.tiers: Municipalities; planned modules for cadastre, property assessment and property tax collection
